notes.notes:

notes.title: ACotGK Version 1.3 Windows
notes.notes:
Announcing Version 1.3 of "The Accursed Crown of the Giant King" for Windows/Steam, available immediately. This is a minor release of the classic-style single player CRPG. Included are a handful of bugfixes.

For more information on ACotGK see: [url=http://prankster.com/acotgk]http://prankster.com/acotgk[/url]

notes.title: ACotGK Update
notes.notes:
First, sorry for slow response to Steam Community messages. I'm new to having a game on Steam and didn't notice them until right now!

I’m working on a minor update. The biggest thing is to add Mac support on Steam. Currently it’s only on the Mac app store. Otherwise just some minor fixes and updates.

After that I’d like to work a bit on map generation and UI, but those are bigger projects. Any feedback, send it my way!

notes.title: ACotGK Release News
notes.notes: "The Accursed Crown of the Giant King" (ACotGK) will release on Monday, August 8, 2022. ACotGK is a classic-style, single-player role-playing game, Windows, Mac, and iOS.
